mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS paymentId, p.member_id AS memberId, m.nickname, m.email, p.payment_type AS paymentType, p.target_id AS targetId, p.transaction_id AS transactionId, p.amount, c.name AS paymentStatus, pm.name AS paymentMethod, p.paid_at AS paidAt, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.payment_id AS servicePaymentId FROM payment p JOIN member m ON p.member_id = m.id JOIN common_code c ON p.status_id = c.id LEFT JOIN common_code pm ON p.pay_method_id = pm.id WHERE c.type = 1 ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT p.id AS paymentId, p.member_id AS memberId, m.nickname, m.email, p.payment_type AS paymentType, p.target_id AS targetId, p.transaction_id AS transactionId, p.amount, c.name AS paymentStatus, pm.name AS paymentMethod, p.paid_at AS paidAt, p.created_at AS createdAt FROM payment p JOIN member m ON p.member_id = m.id JOIN common_code c ON p.status_id = c.id LEFT JOIN common_code pm ON p.pay_method_id = pm.id WHERE c.type = 1 AND c.code = 'PS04' ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE payment SET status_id = ( SELECT id FROM common_code WHERE type = 1 AND code = 'PS04' AND is_active = TRUE ) WHERE id = #{paymentId} AND status_id = ( SELECT id FROM common_code WHERE type = 1 AND code = 'PS05' AND is_active = TRUE )
